title: The pinned derived base-change mate commutes with shifts
statement: For a commutative square of schemes [def-pc-fibre-product], with chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and additive tensor pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback], fix a family of pullback shift comparisons compatible with the composition-pinned counits as in [lem-pc-pinned-pullback-counit-shifts]. The maps of [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] form a natural transformation from Rf_* followed by Lg^* to Lg′^* followed by Rf′_*, and this transformation commutes with every integer shift, using these pullback comparisons and the recorded right-derived direct-image comparisons.

source.place: Canonical base-change mate; Tag 0D5S derived pullback composition; Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Shift/SingleFunctors.lean and Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/DerivedCategory/Basic.lean. Shift verification written by N1.

proof.text: Apply the selected composition-comparison shift theorem to f′,g and g′,f, and the selected adjunction shift theorem to f and f′. Equality transport for pullback functors commutes with shifts by equality elimination.

Form gamma from associators, whiskered composition comparisons, equality transport and the whiskered derived counit. Form tau by the adjunction unit followed by Rf′_* gamma. All factors commute with shifts, so the composition does too. Expanding components and the adjunction Hom-equivalence formula identifies tau.app with the unchanged canonical base-change map.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_pinned_base_change_mate_shifts
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).Additive]
    (s : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y), (derivedPullback.{u, w} f).CommShift ℤ)
    (hs : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y),
      letI := s f
      NatTrans.CommShift (pinnedPullbackCounit.{u, w} f) ℤ)
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (h : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g) :
    letI := s g
    letI := s g'
    ∃ τ : schemeDerivedDirectImage.{u, w, w} f ⋙ derivedPullback.{u, w} g ⟶
        derivedPullback.{u, w} g' ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage.{u, w, w} f',
      (∀ E, τ.app E = schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap.{u, w} f f' g g' h E) ∧
        NatTrans.CommShift τ ℤ
